scope: Sri Yantra native formalization; no SUN labels or cross-domain correspondences

dependency_classes.definition: Relations necessary in the target geometric configuration, independent of a particular construction or solver.
An explicit construction step uses previously available objects to construct a later object.
Order or dependency introduced by an algorithm used to find a realization; not automatically intrinsic to the geometry.
Ordered ritual, contemplative, or liturgical traversal.
Interpretive assignment, correspondence, or meaning attached to a geometric or ritual object.

modal_statuses.definition: Required under the stated admissibility model or invariant across the declared scope.
Permitted but not required under the stated scope.
True of a named realization, construction, solver, lineage, or representation but not established as intrinsic.
Modal force has not been established.

native_layers.contains: geometric entities, incidences, constraints, symmetry and realization-family facts
derivational construction objects and operand/output dependencies
ritual traversals and symbolic assignments, source- and lineage-scoped

sources.title: On the construction of the Sri Yantra
sources.author: Alessandro Chiodo

claims.statement: Up to rescaling and translation, minimally concurrent realizations form a four-parameter family.
Generating triangles t3 and t7 share a circumcircle.
Seven specified triangle apices coincide with base points of other generating triangles.
Twelve specified downward-leg/base/upward-leg triples concur on each side of the symmetry axis.
The middle construction is two-fold, with corresponding constructions beginning from points 5=Z and 6=Q.
Completion reduces to a circle-line-point Apollonius problem with four candidate circles and geometric selection conditions.
A one-dimensional high-precision root solve produces realizations satisfying the encoded Chiodo conditions.
The printed primal adjacency has 69 vertices and 140 edges, while its face table implies a different 142-edge structure; numbering correspondence is unresolved.
Iterative/nested solver-process claims await inspection of the primary text before entering the authoritative ledger.
M1-M18 incidence and construction-dependency claims await inspection of the primary source and coordinate table.

invariants: Relation class and modal status are orthogonal coordinates.
A construction order does not by itself establish an invariant dependency of every realization.
A solver loop may disappear under another solver without changing the target geometry.
Ritual direction and symbolic meaning are overlays, not geometric edges.
No SUN, music, Tree-of-Life, Fludd, Kepler, or cross-domain label may enter the native geometry ledger.
